notes.title: Zipple World - the village market
notes.content:
Village market, bugs fixed

Hello to all,
we have begun to implement the management part of the game, to enrich the gameplay with different and various content.
Perhaps this is the beginning of a different path for the game, which will take  the arcade/action component and also the part of the character management.
Finally the update of the Zipple warrior is complete.

At the end of each successful mission, you go to the market of the village to buy the valuable skills through the coins.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/74344cd7e24a410a5880013e95cea3e7301476b5.jpg

These additional skills will be used at the beginning of the next mission.
These coins will be given away to you by the inhabitants of each village saved, according to precious objects that you recovered and brought home during the battle.
Each skill has its own price.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/d446ae3b44c3e7589b2aa76e592d3db6f61fe2e8.jpg

With the update 1.2 we introduced the main features of Zipple: ammo, energy, autonomy.

In this way, the gameplay has been changed greatly, and now to complete a mission you have to balance all these aspects that are key to continue (examples images).

For this reason, the market was implemented in the village at the end of each mission, which will allow you to buy these attributes in order to better address the challenges ahead.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/2efbd09e2c42641dc55dba3a68622e39471cd177.jpg

Additional coins

    Mystery box: 1 coin
    Grain bag: 2 coins
    Wine: 3 coins
    Generic food: 5 coins
    Magic Potions: 10 coins

Prices

    Ammo (10 coins)
    Energy (20 coins)
    Autonomy (50 coins)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/8580e3de9517c9f789a05583d307827a2424b86e.jpg

The people will give you this money to help you become a legend.

LIVE on Steam!

notes.title: Update 1.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Zipple World, update 1.2 – Zipple autonomy!

Hello to all,
we developed another feature of Zipple, its autonomy in running.
 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/deeec1705a5de1d1dea0ddba07b8d9a4ee6b0d6a.jpg

Zipple is a warrior that runs, runs a lot. But to do this he needs to eat, because the effort is so great, and if the effort becomes too much our hero will not be able to run more.
 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/5af0f239e01746da60d89ef942553c514f48470e.jpg

Also, if the autonomy of Zipple ends, his health will decline slowly, and you will be forced to take more food to survive!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/5f6d04466a163ed230de5a2b6e91e4c54c5ec2a5.jpg 

So, how does Zipple to collect food for their survival?
He can do this by killing enemies and taking the food they deliver!

How to take food?

In fact, the alien enemies have food that was stolen in the villages that they have invaded previously, and the different types of enemies carry different types of food that will give a different autonomy to Zipple!
Every time you kill an enemy, you will see an object-Food (the one with the yellow aura) that you can take.

Types of food: 
-	Grain (the least powerful)
-	Wine
-	Generic food box
-	Magic potions (the most powerful, created by the village druids)
You can take the food objects simply by touching them.
(see images below)
 
 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/80dcfbad6ef933a3a7a68db2994cbddabaca0bc9.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/1d205d50c15f9f3e96e386357b11e99d30ad87d7.jpg

In this way it is ready the magic hat-trick of Zipple characteristics (ammo, energy, autonomy), that you'll have to balance during the mission, for a much richer gameplay!

notes.title: The Update 1.11 for Zipple World is finally LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
The update 1.11 of Zipple World is finally LIVE, with the following new features.

New energy system!
Pick up and carry objects requires energy, and this energy can be gained by Zipple only in battle by killing enemies!

The adventure of  Zipple is getting tougher ...
The magical world of frogs is full of magical items to collect, but this activity is not always easy: it requires the effort and energy of our hero, energy which so often lacks.
Only the battle with the enemies, victories during the duels, can increase the energy and trust of Zipple to continue on its way.
For this reason, from now to collect magic items you need to store energy by killing enemies, and this energy decreases each time you bring an object home (patch 1.11).

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/689b317fdc40eb2380c0bcc38c03d7aa8c445e7e.jpg

Limited ammo!
Now the number of ammo is limited, and you can earn ammo only by bringing home magic items!
Remember that you can kill enemies also by jumping on them.
Every type of magic item will give you a different number of ammo!

Zipple has the ability to continuously shoot, but the magic weapons donated by the shaman this time they are not infinite: the number of shots is limited!
Yes, this time you can retrieve the ammo every time you return home with a magic item, and the number of shots that you earn varies depending on the quality and type of the object retrieved.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/d18a3e75ba6ac9b7baa4b4acfed97ea71a5187fe.jpg

Shaman’s help!

notes.title: The new control panel with fully customizable controls and gameplay is available NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
we finally released the complete game control panel ('Settings' menu) that solves all gameplay problems and enriches the game with an infinite combination of improvements!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/79f7ec57345d25f69a45396d01676cbe508fc0d6.jpg

NEW OPTIONS
Vertical Sensibility (V.Sensibility)
Fundamental option!
This parameter controls the Sensibility and speed of the progression during the Zipple's run!

Horizontal Sensibility (H.Sensibility)
Fundamental option!
This parameter controls the Sensibility and speed of Zipple's rotation!

Camera speed
Fundamental option!
This parameter controls the speed of camera rotation!

Rocks rate
This parameter controls the falling frequency of rocks or bonuses!

Rocks mass
This parameter controls the mass of rocks or bonuses!

Random Rocks
This parameter controls the generation randomness of rocks of bonuses (dimensions, rotation)!

Maze height
Fundamental option!
This parameter controls the complexity and height of procedurally generated mazes.
MIN VALUE: the labyrinth is flat, no climbs or descents, and less complex.
MAX VALUE: the maze is with climbs and descents, with full size.

Music and effects volume
This parameter controls the volume for music and sound effects!

In this way every aspect of the controls and the gameplay is infinitely customizable!
Now you can customize the game according to your tastes, skills, needs and style for an endless fun!
AND NOW, HAVE FUN!!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/77e0c6c5c666ebcc8f1776d7f441f9f96b2084ac.png

notes.title: Zipple World: definitive gameplay improvement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
we finally achieved the goal that many players asked us for a long time: a stable and solid gameplay, described below!

Now if Zipple reaches the border of a platform, then the frog's run stops!
This makes it IMPOSSIBLE to fall in the void while you run, and you can fall only because of external events (enemies, dynamic rocks of obstacles) or during the jump.

notes.title: Zipple World: optimized gameplay!
notes.content:
